name: berakhot-4
approved: Drafted overnight Nov 5–6 2026 by Claude from a line-by-line check against the Gemara and Rashi on Sefaria (each finding re-checked before applying); David asked for fixes to go live overnight. Awaiting review by a rav.

repairs.find: drinking plenty of water while eating protects the intestines
repairs.replace: drinking plenty of water after eating protects the intestines
repairs.why: Rashi explains המקפה as drinking a lot of water after the meal, until the food floats, not while eating.
repairs.source: Berakhot 40a הַמַּקְפֶּה אֲכִילָתוֹ בְּמַיִם; Rashi s.v. המקפה אכילתו במים: שותה מים הרבה אחר אכילתו

repairs.why: This is the middle of the ברייתא brought (דתניא) as the proof that רבי יהודה calls wheat a tree; it opens as ראיה in step 40, and a continuation takes the first half's label.
repairs.source: Berakhot 40a דְּתַנְיָא: אִילָן שֶׁאָכַל מִמֶּנּוּ אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן; rulebook rule 5

repairs.why: רבי יהודה's line in the ברייתא is the actual proof for step 39 (the step itself says 'This completes the proof'), yet it is labelled Statement.
repairs.source: Berakhot 40a רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: חִטָּה הָיְתָה; rulebook rule 5

repairs.why: This is the second half of the קא משמע לן answer to the פשיטא challenge, which ends 40a as תירוץ (step 43); the second half takes the first half's label across the amud break.
repairs.source: Berakhot 40a-b הֵיכָא דְּכִי שָׁקְלַתְּ לֵיהּ לְפֵירֵי... אֲבָל הֵיכָא...; rulebook rule 5

repairs.why: והתניא knocking out the suggested answer of step 7 (וכי תימא) is an objection to an answer, which the rulebook labels Challenge, not Rejection.
repairs.source: Berakhot 41a וְכִי תֵּימָא: הָכִי נָמֵי דְּלֵית לֵיהּ, וְהָתַנְיָא; rulebook rule 2

repairs.why: Matches the corrected label (Challenge).
repairs.source: rulebook rule 2

repairs.find: The גמרא rejects the suggestion of step 7.
repairs.replace: The גמרא challenges the suggestion of step 7 with a ברייתא.
repairs.why: Matches the corrected label (Challenge).
repairs.source: rulebook rule 2

repairs.why: שיעורן כרמונים is the end of the sentence begun in 41a step 18 (labelled ראיה, ״רִמּוֹן״ כְּדִתְנַן: כׇּל כְּלֵי בַּעֲלֵי בָתִּים); the second half takes the first half's label across the amud break.
repairs.source: Berakhot 41a-b ״רִמּוֹן״, כְּדִתְנַן: כׇּל כְּלֵי בַּעֲלֵי בָתִּים... שִׁיעוּרָן כְּרִמּוֹנִים; rulebook rule 5

repairs.why: Rav Nachman objects to Rav Huna's conduct; nothing here pushes aside a proof, so by the rulebook (objection to an action/position, also inside a story) it is a Challenge, not a Rejection.
repairs.source: Berakhot 42a: אמר ליה רב נחמן: עדי כפנא; docs/step-labels.md rules 2-3

repairs.find: Rejects רב הונא's behavior in step 2.
repairs.replace: Challenges רב הונא's behavior in step 2.
repairs.why: Matches the corrected label (Challenge, not Rejection).
repairs.source: Berakhot 42a: עדי כפנא

repairs.why: The students being unable to answer is a line in the middle of the story; the question is answered right after on 43a by the elder (כהסבו דמי), so it is not where the discussion lands.
repairs.source: Berakhot 42b-43a: לא הוה בידייהו... עד דאתא ההוא סבא... ושני להו; docs/step-labels.md rules 3, 5

repairs.why: ולא היא knocks out Rav Pappa's answer (a Resolution), not a proof, so it cannot be a Rejection; it ends the thread with the challenge standing and the ruling of the decider intact, so it is the Conclusion.
repairs.source: Berakhot 43b: ולא היא, לאשתמוטי נפשיה הוא דעבד; Rashi s.v. ולא היא; docs/step-labels.md rules 2, 4

repairs.replace: Overturns the answer of step 25 and closes the story.
repairs.why: Matches the corrected label (Conclusion, not Rejection).
repairs.source: Berakhot 43b: ולא היא

repairs.find: having it pass through your house, meaning eating it regularly, is harmful.
repairs.replace: according to רש״י the 'house' is the belly of the person who eats it, so turnip passing through it is harmful.
repairs.why: Rashi explains 'the house' as the eater's belly (לכרס האוכל לפת), not a household where turnip is eaten often.
repairs.source: Berakhot 44b אוי לו לבית שהלפת עוברת בתוכו; Rashi s.v. אוי לבית: לכרס האוכל לפת

repairs.find: Turnip is harmful to the home where it is eaten.
repairs.replace: Turnip is harmful to the stomach of the one who eats it.
repairs.why: Same error as in deeperAnalysis: per Rashi the 'house' is the eater's belly.
repairs.source: Rashi Berakhot 44b s.v. אוי לבית

repairs.find: Meaning a home where turnip is often eaten.
repairs.replace: רש״י: the 'house' is the belly of the one who eats turnip.
repairs.why: The phrase note contradicts Rashi, who reads 'house' as the eater's belly.
repairs.source: Rashi Berakhot 44b s.v. אוי לבית: לכרס האוכל לפת

repairs.why: רב עמרם's 'ולא פליגי' reconciles two rulings; nothing was challenged before it, so it is not a Resolution (same ruling as the earlier ולא פליגי repair).
repairs.source: Berakhot 44a אמר רב עמרם ולא פליגי הא לן והא להו; docs/step-labels.md

repairs.why: 'ולא פליגי' reconciles רב זביד and רב פפא; no challenge was raised, so it is not a Resolution.
repairs.source: Berakhot 45b ולא פליגי הא דאשכחינהו דקא אמרי נברך; docs/step-labels.md

repairs.why: This finishes the 'שאני התם' answer to the waiter תא שמע, which 45a step 24 labels תירוץ (the source attacks the lenient view, so it is a challenge); the second half takes the first half's label across the amud break.
repairs.source: Berakhot 45a–b שאני התם דניחא להו דמקבע להו בחובה מעיקרא; docs/step-labels.md rules 1, 2, 5

repairs.find: Finishing the rejection of the waiter proof
repairs.replace: Finishing the answer to the waiter challenge
repairs.why: Title names the step as a rejection of a proof; it is the end of the answer to a challenge.
repairs.source: Berakhot 45b; docs/step-labels.md rule 2

repairs.find: The previous proof from the שמש is pushed aside.
repairs.replace: The challenge from the שמש is answered.
repairs.why: Matches the corrected label: the waiter source was a challenge to the lenient view, now answered.
repairs.source: Berakhot 45b; docs/step-labels.md rule 1

repairs.find: Closes the rejection of the previous proof (from the waiter case)
repairs.replace: Completes the answer to the previous challenge (from the waiter case)
repairs.why: Matches the corrected label.
repairs.source: docs/step-labels.md rules 2, 5

repairs.why: 'תסתיים' closes the proof that רבי יוחנן is the strict one, but it is immediately challenged by רבא בר רב הונא (step 14), so it cannot be a Conclusion in the middle; it is the inference ending the proof.
repairs.source: Berakhot 45b תסתיים. אמר ליה רבא בר רב הונא...; docs/step-labels.md rule 5

repairs.why: Title names the step as a Conclusion; it is the end of a proof that is then challenged.
repairs.source: docs/step-labels.md rule 5
